Pixel art with crisp clearly visible pixel edges, limited muted jade/navy/ochre palette and restrained highlights, fully opaque bodies against TRUE alpha transparency. Animals fill at most 76 percent of each cell; never crop bodies. These are individual reusable game assets, NOT an infographic.
